description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
 
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
 
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
 
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.


The Role
As Senior QA Engineer for a new product within Veeva, you will be a founding member of a team building our next major AI-driven platform — one that will transform how Life Sciences companies manage safety, regulatory, and clinical development. The team will be AI-first in two meaningful ways: using AI to drive engineering productivity and strong engineering discipline, and building a product that applies AI in genuinely innovative ways to problems that matter.
 
You'll have significant ownership over the QA process, documentation and tools in a startup-like setting. This role is for a hands-on, self-starter who thrives on balancing performance, cost, and reliability.
 
Within your first 3 months, you will have live customers on the platform and a thriving, growing team behind it - directly accelerating how customers bring life-saving products to market.
What You'll Do
Implement the AI based QA process. You will work closely with engineers and production operations to establish the QA process for Falcon
Own platform test automation. You will develop and maintain automated test-cases for the Falcon platform
Support Releases. You will partner with engineering and production operations to assist with the process and documentation to ensure smooth releases
Maintain test environments and integrations. In partnership with engineering, you will help to maintain the test environments and integrations for Falcon
Requirements
5+ years of hands-on experience in a QA role, with a strong focus on automation, tooling, and process oversight
Hands-on experience writing and maintaining automated test suites covering sanity, boundary, negative, concurrency, and compatibility scenarios
Programming Skills: You have extensive experience in a programming language like Python, TypeScript or Java
Strong technical background in Unix/Linux command-line environments for log analysis and backend debugging
Proficiency with SQL for database querying and data validation
Hands-on experience with API testing tools (e.g., Postman, REST Assured)
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Applicants must have the unrestricted right to work in the United States. Veeva will not provide sponsorship at this time
Nice to Have
Experience utilizing AI testing tools, prompt engineering for test-case generation, LLM output evaluation, or generative AI to optimize testing workflows
Proficiency in scripting languages like Bash or Python
Experience with observability tools (Grafana, Prometheus, Elasticsearch)
Knowledge of artifact management solutions (Nexus, ECR)
Familiarity with code validation and linting tools (Sonar)
Interviewing with Veeva
We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
Follow the application process and submit your resume.
Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.
Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
A conversation with the hiring manager
A practical case exercise
A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
Perks & Benefits
Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
Retirement programs
1% charitable giving program
Compensation
Base pay: $80,000 - $150,000
The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
